text:
Ana: Quick sync thread — sales wants a tight obs story for the Beta demo next Thurs. We need a trimmed scope we can fully ship and demo.
Devon: High level asks from demos: (1) per-route cost card, (2) trace link from error rows to sampled model spans, (3) lightweight time-series of cost by tag.
Ravi: Backend note: route attribution requires joining request metadata -> billing events. We can approximate with batch aggregation first, streaming later.
Sam: UX suggestion: default view shows top 5 routes by cost with % and an action to open traces or export. Minimal and focused.
Ana: Proposal for Beta cut (must ship): per-route daily cost rollup + Console card + export CSV. Should-have for Beta if time: trace link from errors -> sample span. Won't do full trace UI.
Devon: Rough estimates: cost rollups pipeline ~2 backend-weeks + 3 days frontend. CSV export + permissions + e2e ~2 days. Trace-link POC ~1.5 weeks.
Ravi: Risks: tagging inconsistency from clients, timezones, and partial requests that span multiple routes. We'll doc assumptions and show confidence intervals.
Heather: Customers (Dedicated) asked for 60d retention for cost and 90d for audit logs. Beta can do 30d; commit migration path to 90d for enterprise.
Sam: Acceptance criteria (Beta):
- Card shows daily cost per-route for last 7 days (numbers reconcile to billing within 10%).
- Export button produces CSV with route, date, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_estimate.
- Feature flag present and per-deployment opt-in.
Devon: Canary metrics to watch: token_cost_delta (between aggregation and billing), card_render_latency, CSV-job-error-rate.
Ravi: Implementation plan: 1) event matcher job (batch) 2) aggregation store (per-route TTL configurable) 3) Console card + export endpoint. No runtime hooks for first cut.
Ana: Trace link approach (optional): runtime emits a lightweight span id in response headers when sampling hits. Console links to traces API to fetch minimal span summary. Must be opt-in and default off.
Heather: Compliance ask: audit trail for toggles and exports. Ensure that export events are logged to audit stream.
Sam: UX checklist: compact card, row actions (view traces / export), tooltip for cost calc, empty state copy. I'll put a small mock in Figma by Tues.
Devon: Dev assignments: I'll own backend aggregation. Ravi will own runtime header + trace API POC. Sam owns UI and mocks. Heather will collect compliance requirements. Ana will coordinate demos.
ops-bot: Created ticket OBS-5401: per-route-cost-rollup assigned to @Devon
Ana: Timeline suggestion: start aggregation this sprint, aim for Beta demo cut in 3 weeks. Trace-link if time as a backwards-compatible opt-in.
Ravi: I'll prototype header emission with sampling=0.2% and KV-span-filter to avoid high-cardinality spans.
Sam: We need acceptance test + demo script. Ana can we get a rehearsed flow?
Ana: Yes — I'll prepare the one-pager and rehearsal slot on Wed. Please add any blocker comments here before EOD tomorrow.
